newsitem.title: USA: TVA boosting power at 1,065 MW Ala. nuke.
newsitem.headline: TVA boosting power at 1,065 MW Ala. nuke.

text.p: TVA Nuclear was boosting power at its 1,065 megawatt (MW) Browns Ferry nuclear power unit 2 to 60 percent of capacity as of early Thursday following a power reduction, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.

The unit, located in Decatur, Ala., was expected to hold at 60 percent power for "scram time testing" then ramp up to 100 percent of output when testing is complete, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Browns Ferry 2 reduced power output to 29 percent of capacity over the weekend for maintenance work on a drain heater.
The unit was operating at 58 percent of capacity as of early Thursday, the NRC said in its report.

The adjacent 1,065 MW Browns Ferry nuclear power unit 1 has been shut since 1985, while the 1,065 MW Browns Ferry nuclear unit 3 was operating at 81 percent of capacity as of early Thursday as it coasted down to a scheduled 19-day outaged slated to begin February 21, the NRC said.
